documents.text: Valeri Bragin Valeri Nikolayevich Bragin (); born May 31, 1956, is a retired Russian ice hockey forward. He is former coach of the HC CSKA Moscow team in the KHL. Valeri Bragin started his career with HC Spartak Moscow where he played in the top Soviet league from 1978. In 1981 he joined Khimik Voskresensk where he played for 8 seasons. In 1989 Bragin moved to Denmark where he was the player/coach for Rødovre SIK in the Danish League. He won the Danish title with Rødovre in 1990. In that season he was also named league player of the year.
